	int flag, type;

			inputEnd=(inputBuffer=ibuf)+fread(ibuf,1,BUFFER_SIZE,stdin);
			return inputPtr==inputEnd ? EOF : *inputPtr++;
		}
		return *inputPtr++;
	}
	template<class T> void read(T& x) {
		flag=1; ch=gc();
		while(ch<'0'||ch>'9') { if(ch=='-') flag=-1; ch=gc(); }
		x=0;
		while(ch>='0'&&ch<='9') { x=x*10+(ch&15); ch=gc(); }
		x*=flag;
	}

using namespace io;
int n,k,p;
int bits[MAXN];
ull x[26][MAXN], factorial[MAXN], invFactorial[MAXN], base, result;
ull power(ull baseVal, int exp=p-2) {
	ull res=1;
	while(exp) {
		if(exp&1) res=res*baseVal%p;
		baseVal=baseVal*baseVal%p;
		exp>>=1;
	}
	return res;
}
ull dfs(int depth, int num) {
	if(bits[num]<depth) return 0;
	if(depth==1) return x[depth][num];
	if(x[depth][num]) return x[depth][num];
	int count=0;
	for(int mask=num&(num-1); mask; mask=num&(mask-1))
		if(bits[mask]>=depth-1) {
			x[depth][num]+=dfs(depth-1,mask)*x[num^mask][num];
			if(++count==18) { count=0; x[depth][num]%=p; }
		}

	return x[depth][num];
}

	return factorial[n]*invFactorial[m]%p*invFactorial[n-m]%p;

	#ifndef ONLINE_JUDGE
	freopen("255x.in","r",stdin);

	result=0;

	return 0;
